name: Danceteria
heard: Ansaturi / Dan Saturday / Dance Tyria / Dancer Jerky / Congo Bills
context: Rudolf's club: first an illegal after-hours club on 37th Street in the Garment District, busted once it got too famous; then the legal second Danceteria with bands on every floor. Rudolf says the name came from someone passing a cafeteria and wanting a 'dancing area'; Congo Bill's, its fourth-floor lounge, is where Fenton and Randy DJed and met Michael Alig, then a busboy (00:33:16)

name: New York

name: Brazil

name: Los Angeles

name: The Tunnel
context: Rudolf's club, opened just as Nell's took the cool crowd; he and Michael Alig made its basement the Club Kids' base. Rudolf says there's a second tunnel the same size underneath

name: Berlin
context: Rudolf's home city: isolated by the Wall, cheap for young people and, as he puts it, extremely urban, hard and nuts - good training for New York

name: Michael Alig
heard: Michael / Michael Alec / Michael Alick / Michael Eilig
context: Rudolf gave him a busboy job at Danceteria to stop him pestering the office, then his first nights; together they made the Tunnel basement the Club Kids' home. name: Club Kids
